theorems.name: Submission.dorag_affine_approximation
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ), 0 < n → ∃ δ₃ C₃ : ℝ, 0 < δ₃ ∧ δ₃ ≤ 1 / 8 ∧ 1 ≤ C₃ ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ δ₃ → ∀ (U W : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (R : IMRep U n) (H : Euclid (n + k) → Euclid (n + k)) (κ ρ : ℝ) (z : Euclid (n + k)), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → 0 < ρ → closedBall z ρ ⊆ W → AEStronglyMeasurable H R.measure → (∀ x, ‖H x‖ ≤ κ) → (∀ X : Euclid (n + k) → Euclid (n + k), ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ W → R.firstVariation X = -∫ x, inner ℝ (X x) (H x) ∂R.measure) → z ∈ R.measure.support → R.measure (closedBall z ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + δ) * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n) → κ * ρ ≤ δ → ∀ ξ ∈ R.measure.support ∩ closedBall z (2 * δ * ρ), ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ 2 * δ * ρ → ∃ S : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + k)), Module.finrank ℝ S = n ∧ (∀ x ∈ R.measure.support ∩ closedBall ξ r, ‖(x - ξ) - S.starProjection (x - ξ)‖ ≤ C₃ * δ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / (2 * (n : ℝ) + 2)) * r) ∧ ∫⁻ x in closedBall ξ (r / 2), ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin (n + k), ‖(approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C₃ * (δ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / (2 * (n : ℝ) + 2))) ^ 2 * (r / 2) ^ n)
